notes: From Webs: news, polls, trivia, a countdown, a mystery box and more right under the search box (Customize start page can hide it)
Calling cards, theme days, the owner's quote and the wallpaper of the week, if you want it
Secret words and a secret code hunt in the address bar, limited-time achievements and Phantom calendar stickers
Games: a weekly leaderboard with a nickname you pick, community goals, and sometimes the owner's daily word
Help & support: common questions, problem reports with their answers, and rating the help
Anonymous counts (the version and your country, never what you browse); Settings → Privacy and security turns them off
